criteria.criterion: Veterinary clinic group with 5-30 locations (ten clinics in Missouri)
Founder/family-owned, not PE (100% family-owned, started by a veterinarian and her family, declined outside money)
US-based (Missouri; HQ Linn Creek per claim)

c1.note: The company's own About page states 100% family-owned, ten clinics, founded 2016, and no PE. The names Rericha and Linn Creek were not seen in the pages I read, so those details are unconfirmed, but they do not affect the thesis criteria.
